CONFIDENCE WAS DETERMINED TO BE HIGH GIVEN THE ASSOCIATION WITH A REPEAT LEAK SOURCE AND VISIBLE CHROMATIC CHARACTERISTICS. properties.summary: Incident Type: MOBILE - NRC Report ID: 938937 - Medium Affected: WATER - Suspected Responsible Party: U.S.A. TRUCK INC.
properties.content:
NRC Report ID: 938937
Incident Time: 2010-05-03 09:50:00
Nearest City: Norwich, CT
Incident Type: MOBILE
Material: OIL: DIESEL
Medium Affected: WATER
Suspected Responsible Party: U.S.A. TRUCK INC.
Skytruth Analysis
Reported Spill Volume: 60 gallons
A TRACTOR-TRAILER VEHICLE MAKING A DELIVERY TO THE FACILITY ACCIDENTALLY STRUCK A GUARD RAIL WHILE TURNING IN THE PARKING LOT AND RUPTURED A FUEL TANK RELEASING AN ESTIMATED 60 GALLONS OF FUEL OIL TO THE PAVEMENT. A LIGHT SHEEN WAS OBSERVED ON THE RIVER FOLLOWING THE INCIDENT.
